# Ezekiel 23 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The LORD spoke to me:

**2** "Son of man, there were once two sisters, daughters of the same mother.

**3** They became prostitutes in Egypt while they were still young — that's where their promiscuity started.

**4** The older sister was Oholah, and the younger was Oholibah. I married them both, and they gave Me sons and daughters. Oholah represents Samaria, and Oholibah represents Jerusalem.

**5** Even though Oholah belonged to Me, she lusted after the Assyrians — her lovers —

**6** those handsome young soldiers dressed in blue uniforms — governors and commanders, all of them riding horses.

**7** She threw herself at the finest men of Assyria and defiled herself with all their idols — every single one she chased after.

**8** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**9** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**10** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**11** Her sister Oholibah watched all this — and then outdid her! Her lust and promiscuity were even worse than her sister's.

**12** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**13** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**14** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**15** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**16** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**17** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**18** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**19** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**20** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**21** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**22** So the Lord GOD says: Oholibah, I am going to turn your former lovers against you — the very ones you grew to despise. I will bring them against you from every direction.

**23** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**24** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**25** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**26** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**27** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**28** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**29** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**30** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**31** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**32** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**33** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**34** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**35** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**36** The LORD said to me, "Son of man, are you ready to pass judgment on Oholah and Oholibah? Then confront them with their disgusting sins.

**37** They committed adultery, and their hands are covered in blood. They cheated on Me with their idols. Worse, they sacrificed their own children — the children they bore for Me — burning them as offerings to idols.

**38** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**39** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**43** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**44** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**45** But righteous judges will sentence them as adulteresses and murderers — because that's exactly what they are.

**46** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**47** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**48** She piled sin on sin, chasing after foreign nations, sleeping with their idols — never giving up the promiscuity that started when she was young in Egypt.

**49** You will be repaid for your prostitution and your idol worship. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **23:2-4**: Two sisters, same mother, same bad choices — but one should have learned from the other's fate. Samaria fell to Assyria. Jerusalem watched and said, 'That won't happen to us' — and then did worse.

- **23:11**: Watching someone else's disaster and learning nothing from it — that's Oholibah's defining sin. She had a front-row seat to her sister's downfall and didn't change a thing.

- **23:37**: The worst charge: they sacrificed their own children to idols. Not strangers' children — their own, the children God considered His. There is no deeper betrayal imaginable.

— PNEUMA
